subject: Post-call: evidence intake & retention timeline — Aurelia Bank
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Patel <naomi.patel@aureliabank.com>, Tom Chen <tom.chen@aureliabank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: evidence intake & retention timeline — Aurelia Bank

Hi Naomi / Tom —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and our proposed next steps so we can unblock the compliance review on your side. Short version first, details below.

Top pain points you called out:
- Audit log retention: need 7 years of immutable audit logs with exportable CSVs and certificate of storage location.
- SOC 2 artifacts: you want evidence (control descriptions, configuration screenshots, user access lists) for a SOC 2 readiness review.
- Data residency & DPA: confirmation that transaction data can be set to US-only regions and a DPA with an addendum for financial data retention.
- Pen test window: you are planning an internal pen test in July and need an agreed schedule and pre-test checklist.

Goals we agreed on:
1) Provide an evidence bundle for an initial SOC 2 readiness pass by Apr 10.
2) Deliver an export of the last 30 days of audit logs in CSV format and a retention mapping doc by Apr 9.
3) Draft DPA language and a retention addendum for review by Apr 16.
4) Lock a tentative pen-test window and pre-test requirements by Apr 20.

Who owns what (proposed):
- Diego (me): collate audit-log export + retention mapping; deliver Apr 9.
- Marissa: lead DPA/redlines and commercial points; draft to you by Apr 16.
- Naomi / Tom: confirm which user lists (SAML identities) need to be included in access artifact; confirm pen-test scope (external only vs internal)

Attachments I’m sending with this email: SOC2_summary_Aurelia_2025.pdf (high-level controls map), auditlog_sample_20260331.csv (anonymized sample), retention_matrix_v1.xlsx (proposed mapping).

Next call — proposed: 30 minutes week of Apr 12 to walk the artifacts and any gaps. I can do Mon/Tue afternoon PT.

If that all looks good I’ll start assembling the artifact packet.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
Diego.fernandez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0133

From: Naomi Patel <naomi.patel@aureliabank.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Chen <tom.chen@aureliabank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2026 16:40:12 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: evidence intake & retention timeline — Aurelia Bank

Diego — thanks for the clear recap. That aligns with what we need. A few clarifications: 

1) Audit logs: we need immutable logs for the following events at minimum: authentication (success/failure), API token creation, model selection/serving events, and admin role changes. CSV sample looks good; can you include column headers in the export: timestamp, event_type, user_id, ip, resource_id, request_id?

2) SOC 2 artifacts: beyond the control map, can you include a recent penetration test summary (if available) and the latest vulnerability management policy? If a formal pen test report isn’t available, a dated pre-test checklist is acceptable for now.

3) DPA addendum: retention addendum needs to mention backup retention windows and obligations upon termination. Also confirm whether we can request a deletion certificate for accounts terminated within 60 days.

Finally, pen test scope: we are planning an external penetration test (customer-led) that will include your hosted API endpoints and the console. We’ll share a formal scope doc by next Wed (Apr 8).

Naomi
Naomi Patel
Head of Security Assurance, Aurelia Bank
naomi.patel@aureliabank.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Patel <naomi.patel@aureliabank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tom Chen <tom.chen@aureliabank.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2026 08:12:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: evidence intake & retention timeline — Aurelia Bank

Hi Naomi —

Great notes; thanks for the specifics. Quick replies inline to keep things actionable:

1) Audit log columns — yes, we’ll include: timestamp, event_type, user_id (hashed), ip, resource_id, request_id. I’ll attach an export with headers; sample provided earlier was anonymized which is why it looked sparse. Full 30-day export will be generated by Apr 9.

2) Pen test artifacts — we do have a high-level pen test summary from our Q4 2025 assessment (attestation-level summary, not the full report). I’ll include that as part of the SOC2 evidence bundle. If you need the full report we’ll need a standard NDA/process; we can discuss.

3) DPA / deletion certificate — short answer: we support account-level deletion and can provide a confirmation certificate within 60 days for terminated accounts. I’ll have Marissa draft the DPA addendum language and call out backup retention windows explicitly.

Action items I’m tracking now:
- Diego: full 30-day audit log export (CSV with headers) + retention mapping by EOD Apr 9.
- Diego: include Q4-2025 pen-test summary in artifact zip by Apr 10.
- Marissa: DPA addendum draft + retention clause for review by Apr 16.
- Aurelia: share pen-test scope doc by Apr 8; confirm user lists to include in access artifacts.

Attachments: I’m re-attaching the files I sent on Friday and a short readme with column definitions.

I can hold Tue Apr 13 10:00–10:30 PT for a walk-through. If Tue doesn’t work, propose alternatives and I’ll adjust.

Thanks —
Diego

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Patel <naomi.patel@aureliabank.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: evidence intake & retention timeline — Aurelia Bank

Hi Naomi / Diego —

Adding myself here. I’ll take point on the DPA addendum and commercial items. A few commercial notes up front so legal has context:
- If Aurelia requests custom retention guarantees beyond our standard offering we’ll need to scope whether this is a policy-based configuration or a contractual SLA (may impact pricing).
- For the trial / pilots: we can extend a 60-day evaluation with audit-log exports and limited retention settings for the pilot environment — happy to put that on paper if you want to proceed.

I’ll circulate a first-pass DPA addendum by Apr 16 and include language about deletion certificates and backup window commitments. Diego — please loop me the audit log export when it’s ready so I can reference exact wording in the addendum.

Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0178
